Definition: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
BiblicalUsage: Egypt is the land of bondage and the land of refuge, and its name runs through the whole of Scripture. Abram went down into Egypt in the famine, God says He has seen the affliction of His people which is in Egypt, and the firstborn of Egypt were smitten in one night.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Egypt is the picture of the world: it feeds you in the famine and enslaves you after, and the God who brought His people out of it is the God who brings His people out still.
